title: Maximal sublattices of convex geometries: four counterexamples
summary: Adaricheva, Mata, Silberger and Zamojska-Dzienio conjectured that in a finite convex geometry, and more generally in a finite join-semidistributive lattice, the complement of a maximal sublattice is a union of intervals with a common least element, and proved this for convex dimension two. We give convex geometries of convex dimension four and three in which such a complement has two and three minimal elements, so their theorem does not extend.
